ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var sid = java.get('sid');
let i = String(book.bookUrl).includes('https:/');
if (i) { sid = String(book.bookUrl).match(/\d{3,}$/);}

cache.deleteMemory('pxcjj'); //仅通过正文打开详情，防错
if (sid == '🇨🇳') {
	let Info=source.getLoginInfoMap();
	let bkn = String(book.name);
	let id = java.hexDecodeToString(result).match(/\d+$/)[0];
	Info['书名'] = '';
	cache.put('pxsid','');
	Info['章节'] = bkn;
	cache.put('pxid',id);
	source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(Info));
	let length = leng(bkn);	
book.intro = (source.get('bq')==1?String(java.get('tags')).replace(/, /g,' #').replace('[','　　#').replace(']','\n　　'):'') + (length>18?('《'+book.name+'》\n'):'') + java.get('jianjie');
	rr='1';

} else {
let url = 'https://app-api.pixiv.net/v2/novel/series?series_id=' + sid;
//修正bookurl
book.bookUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(url)},{"type":"px"}`;

try {

jg = java.connect(gethd(url));
rr = jg.body();
if (jg.code() == 400) {
	source.login();
	Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(500);
	rr = java.ajax(gethd(url));
	}

} catch(err) {
	rr={};
	java.toast('详情页链接加载失败'+sid);
	}

//设置解析结果
java.setContent(rr);


//更新更新时间
try {
let tm = java.getString('$.novel_series_latest_novel.create_date');
let d = new Date(tm);
d = java.timeFormatUTC(d,'yy/MM/dd',8*60*60*1000);
book.kind = String(book.kind).replace(/\d+\/\d+\/\d+|$/,d).replace('null','');
} catch(err) {java.toast('详情页内容错误');}

//获取书名并净化
let bkn = String(java.getString('$.novel_series_detail.title')).replace(/^《(.+)》$/,'$1');
book.name = bkn.replace(/[(（].{0,9}((?:仙侠|纯爱|后宫|萝莉).?){3,}.{0,9}[)）](?=\s*[一-ꀀ])/,'');

//java.log('┌获取书名\n[99:99.999] └'+book.name);

//获取书名失败
if (book.name == '') {
	//效果，unicode转字符
	// let ee = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(rr) );
	let txte = java.getString('$..user_message',rr);
	//弹出提示，sid相应序列不存在
	java.longToast('\n未获取到书名\n'+txte);
	} else {
	
	//放入书名
	let Info=source.getLoginInfoMap();
	Info['书名'] = book.name;
	cache.put('pxsid',sid);
	Info['章节'] = '';
	cache.put('pxid','');
	source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(Info));
	
	//同名共存
	if (source.get('gc') == 1) book.name='📘'+book.name;
	}

//补充封面链接
if (book.coverUrl == null) {
	let img = java.getString('$.novel_series_latest_novel.image_urls.large');
	book.coverUrl = gethdi(img);
		
//java.log('┌获取封面\n[99:99.999] └'+book.coverUrl);
}

//计算书名长度
let length = leng(String(book.name));
//大于18个全角字符
if (length > 18) length= '《'+String(book.name).replace(/^📘/,'')+'》\n';
else length = '';
let jianjie = java.getString('$.novel_series_detail.caption');
book.intro = (source.get('bq')==1?String(java.get('tags')).replace(/, /g,' #').replace('[','　　#').replace(']','\n　　'):'') + length + java.get('jianjie');
java.put('jianjie',jianjie);
java.put("bookr",rr);
}
util.xq_trans.call(this);
rr
</js>

			else url = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(sid)},{"type":""}`;}
		else if (key.startsWith('正文@')) {
			url = 'https://app-api.pixiv.net/v1/search/novel?filter=for_android&merge_plain_keyword_results=true&sort=date_desc&search_target=text&word='+key.slice(3);}
		else { url = 'https://app-api.pixiv.net/v1/search/novel?filter=for_android&merge_plain_keyword_results=true&word='+key;}
source.put('nurls','http://127.0.0.1'); //重置储存的下一页

} else {url = source.get('nurls');}

bookSourceComment:
v1.0添加了登录功能
v1.1更改了分类标签相关规则
v1.2添加了注册功能，优化了代码可读性（不清楚，也许只有我能看懂这坨）
v1.3修复图片不加载的问题
v1.4做了一点点优化
v1.5做了一点点优化
v1.6更改了正文获取方式，删除登录功能，改用网页登录
v1.7优化发现页
v1.8改了下ua，如果无法加载正文，尝试将登录url改成正文网址并通过一下cf验证
v1.9由于详情页api失效并且技术有限抓不到新的，因此修改详情页获取方式，由于某些原因，正文需要使用特定字体，最下方下载一个适合自己的字体，推荐otf格式
v1.91修了下详情页封面获取
v2.0尝试使用json字典替换正文，现在可以不需要特定字体，特别感谢xubai提供的字典
v2.1将并发率设置成3.3秒，优化详情页
v2.2，uaa取消了正文的字体防盗，所以删除相关功能
v2.3 目录api紧接着失效，改用网页
v2.4 修复目录会多出几章假章节的bug
v2.5 修复正文出现奇怪数字的问题，添加书籍URL正则，可以直接用URL添加书籍，以及其他小优化（其实是只记得有改了其他但是具体什么忘了）
v2.6优化发现页
v2.7添加了正则去除正文页尾的uaa发布地址
v2.8当触发防盗时正文直接返回空并用弹窗提示，解决缓存时触发了防盗但是不知道的问题
v2.9更新正则表达式，去除正文页尾多余的东西（最近多出来个"VIP会员免广告"影响观感）

<js>
 intro=`
 	 
 📖 书名：{{@@h1@text}}
 👤 作者：{{@@p.0@a.0@text}}
 🔖 标签：{{@@p.3@a[href~=tag]@text##\s##,}}
 🕰 最新：{{@@p.0@a.1@text}}
 {{@@.tLJ@text}}
 🏷 简介：{{@@class.intro@text##htt.+l}}
 `;
 let pl = '\n­\n【✨评论✨】\n';
  
 try {
     let p = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result).select('input[name=novel_id]').attr('value');
     let pi = `{{getUrl()}}index.php?s=/Home/comment/lists/id/${p}/type/novel/limit/5/size/12`;
     let po = String(java.ajax(pi)).match(/trre\=([\s\S]+),page_num/)[1] || 1;
     var datas = JSON.parse(po);
  
     // 获取当前用户UID（从登录cookie中提取）
     let myuid = null;
     if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
         try {
             let jc = source.getLoginHeaderMap();
             let inf = decodeURIComponent(jc.get("Cookie"));
             let info = decodeURIComponent(inf).match(/\{[\s\S]+\}/)?.[0];
             if (info) myuid = JSON.parse(info)['uid'];
         } catch(e) { java.log('用户信息解析失败') }
     }
  
     // 时间格式化函数 
     function formatTime(timestamp) {
         return new Date(timestamp * 1000).toLocaleString();
     }
  
     // 处理我的评论数据
     var myComments = [];
     function collectMyComments(comment, parentPath) {
         let floor = parentPath ? `${parentPath}-${comment.floorIndex}` : comment.floorIndex;
         if (myuid && comment.uid === Number(myuid)) {
             myComments.push({
                 id: comment.id,
                 username: comment.user?.username || "已注销用户",
                 group: comment.user?.group || "",
                 floor: `【${floor}楼】`,
                 time: formatTime(comment.create_time),
                 content: comment.content
             });
         }
         if (comment._?.forEach) {
             comment._.forEach((child, index) => {
                 child.floorIndex = index + 1;
                 collectMyComments(child, floor);
             });
         }
     }
  
     // 处理全部评论数据 
     function buildComments(comment, parentPath, level = 0) {
         let floor = parentPath ? `${parentPath}-${comment.floorIndex}` : comment.floorIndex;
         let indent = '  '.repeat(level);
         let str = `${indent}⏱️${formatTime(comment.create_time)}\n` +
 
 `${indent}👤${comment.user?.username || "已注销用户"} | ${comment.user?.group || ""}\n` +
                   `${indent}💬 ${comment.content}\n` +
                   `${indent}📍 ${floor}楼\n\n`;
  
         if (comment._?.forEach) {
             comment._.forEach((child, index) => {
                 child.floorIndex = index + 1;
                 str += buildComments(child, floor, level + 1);
             });
         }
         return str;
     }
  
     // 执行处理 
     datas.forEach((c, i) => {
         c.floorIndex = i + 1;
         collectMyComments(c, "");
     });
  
     // 构建输出
     var output = intro + pl;
     if (myComments.length > 0) {
         output += "=== 我的评论（共" + myComments.length + "条） ===\n\n";
         myComments.forEach(m => {
             output += `⏱️${m.time}\n👤${m.username} | ${m.group}\n💬 ${m.content}\n📍 ${m.floor}\n\n`;
         });
     }
  
     output += "=== 全部评论（共" + datas.length + "条） ===\n\n";
     datas.forEach((c, i) => {
         c.floorIndex = i + 1;
         output += buildComments(c, "");
     });
  
     result = output;
 } catch (e) {
     java.log('评论加载错误：' + e);
     result = intro + pl + "本书暂时没有评论或加载失败";
 }
 </js>

bookSourceComment:
幻梦轻小说全网最齐全的轻小说网，访问速度优质而且网页内置插图，拥有海量的轻小说书籍，如果有网页bug或者需求的小说可以进网站群及时反馈
作者留言：
1.0更新：本网站所有的小说都是免费的，目前已经有了PC端和wap端，APP端目前还有点问题需要调试
本次初次制作好了对接阅读的书源，但是为了避免被大规模盗刷流量，书源暂时没有对接插图
2.0更新：本次更新解决了插图问题，让书源可以显示插图，显示不出来多刷新就行
站长在Cdn处新增速率限制，超过限制会被拉黑，国外地区也会无法访问插图，非官网访问也会无法访问插图
如果后续阅读方面流量过于异常，我会关闭阅读的阅读插图渠道，希望各位可以理解
2.1更新：新增发现页面的选项功能，用户可以更快速便捷的从分类和题材中寻找自己想要的小说
2.2更新：修复发现页面的分类功能异常的问题，现在移除文库分类
2.3更新：修复发现界面过于拥挤，点击作者无法快速搜索作者，总有几本推荐阅读始终占据分类书籍顶部的问题，这里感谢QQ用户雪隐梅香提供的修复
2.4更新：优化了插图排版的问题，如果插图不是一张图片一页，可以尝试在阅读界面右上角手动把图片样式改为SINGLE
2.5更新：本次网站将图床更换为了下行宽带200M的服务器，方便大家更快的使用。与此同时修复了更换图床后，插图异常不显示的问题
更多详情内容，可以关注：www.huanmengacg.com
QQ讨论群：907189428

	}
	push("——",'',0.25,0.25)
	push("——",'',0.25,0.25)
	//完本:3
	JSON.stringify(sort);

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

bookSourceComment:
v1.0添加了登录功能
v1.1更改了分类标签相关规则
v1.2添加了注册功能，优化了代码可读性（不清楚，也许只有我能看懂这坨）
v1.3修复图片不加载的问题
v1.4做了一点点优化
v1.5做了一点点优化
v1.6更改了正文获取方式，删除登录功能，改用网页登录
v1.7优化发现页
v1.8改了下ua，如果无法加载正文，尝试将登录url改成正文网址并通过一下cf验证
v1.9由于详情页api失效并且技术有限抓不到新的，因此修改详情页获取方式，由于某些原因，正文需要使用特定字体，最下方下载一个适合自己的字体，推荐otf格式
v1.91修了下详情页封面获取
v2.0尝试使用json字典替换正文，现在可以不需要特定字体，特别感谢xubai提供的字典
v2.1将并发率设置成3.3秒，优化详情页
v2.2，uaa取消了正文的字体防盗，所以删除相关功能
v2.3 目录api紧接着失效，改用网页
v2.4 修复目录会多出几章假章节的bug
v2.5 修复正文出现奇怪数字的问题，添加书籍URL正则，可以直接用URL添加书籍，以及其他小优化（其实是只记得有改了其他但是具体什么忘了）
v2.6优化发现页
v2.7添加了正则去除正文页尾的uaa发布地址
v2.8当触发防盗时正文直接返回空并用弹窗提示，解决缓存时触发了防盗但是不知道的问题
v2.9更新正则表达式，去除正文页尾多余的东西（最近多出来个"VIP会员免广告"影响观感）
*需要登录！否则大部分书籍无法观看全部！*

<js>
v = String(source.getVariable()).split(",");
x=v[2]
 if (baseUrl.match(/novel/)){
name=`{{@@class.novel_box@class.info_box@tag.h1.0@text}}`
author=`{{@@class.novel_box@class.info_box@class.item.1@a@text}}`
kind=`{{book.kind}}`
word=`{{book.wordCount}}`
last=`{{@@class.novel_box@class.info_box@class.item.0@text##最新：}}`

try {
    const response = java.ajax(`{{getUrl()}}api/novel/app/novel/comments?novelId=@get:{bid}&sortType=1&page=${x}&rows=5`);
    const jsonData = JSON.parse(response);
    const logOutput = jsonData.data.map(comment => {
        const cleanNickName = comment.updateTime.replace(/T/g,'  ').replace(/\..*/g, '');
        // 根据分数生成星星显示
        const generateStars = (score) => {
            let starCount = Math.min(Math.floor(score / 2), 5);
            let stars = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                stars += i < starCount? '★' : '☆';
            }
            return stars;
        };
        const starDisplay = generateStars(comment.score);
        return `
  [${cleanNickName}]  ${comment.createTimeFormat}
⛄【${comment.nickName}】:👍🏻${comment.score} ${starDisplay}
 ${comment.content}
 \n­
 
`;
    }).join('\n');
    //java.log(logOutput);
} catch (error) {
    const errorLog = {
        [SyntaxError.name]: '数据解析失败: ',
        default: 'AJAX请求失败: '
    }[error.name || 'default'] + error.message;
    java.log(errorLog);
}

intro=info+`\n­\n【✨评论✨】最新\n­${logOutput}`

<js>
let replaceCover = (u) => {
// java.log(u)
if (u.startsWith("https://")) u = u.substring(8)
else u = u.substring(7)
let uArr = u.split("/")
uArr[0] = "https://p6-novel.byteimg.com/origin"
let uArr2 = []
uArr.forEach((x) => {
    if (!x.includes("?") && !x.includes("~")) uArr2.push(x)
    else uArr2.push(x.split("~")[0])
	})
u = uArr2.join("/")
return u
	}

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
 intro=`
 	 
 📖 书名：{{@@h1@text}}
 👤 作者：{{@@p.0@a.0@text}}
 🔖 标签：{{@@p.3@a[href~=tag]@text##\s##,}}
 🕰 最新：{{@@p.0@a.1@text}}
 {{@@.tLJ@text}}
 🏷 简介：{{@@class.intro@text##htt.+l}}
 `;
 let pl = '\n­\n【✨评论✨】\n';
  
 try {
     let p = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result).select('input[name=novel_id]').attr('value');
     let pi = `{{getUrl()}}index.php?s=/Home/comment/lists/id/${p}/type/novel/limit/5/size/12`;
     let po = String(java.ajax(pi)).match(/trre\=([\s\S]+),page_num/)[1] || 1;
     var datas = JSON.parse(po);
  
     // 获取当前用户UID（从登录cookie中提取）
     let myuid = null;
     if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
         try {
             let jc = source.getLoginHeaderMap();
             let inf = decodeURIComponent(jc.get("Cookie"));
             let info = decodeURIComponent(inf).match(/\{[\s\S]+\}/)?.[0];
             if (info) myuid = JSON.parse(info)['uid'];
         } catch(e) { java.log('用户信息解析失败') }
     }
  
     // 时间格式化函数 
     function formatTime(timestamp) {
         return new Date(timestamp * 1000).toLocaleString();
     }
  
     // 处理我的评论数据
     var myComments = [];
     function collectMyComments(comment, parentPath) {
         let floor = parentPath ? `${parentPath}-${comment.floorIndex}` : comment.floorIndex;
         if (myuid && comment.uid === Number(myuid)) {
             myComments.push({
                 id: comment.id,
                 username: comment.user?.username || "已注销用户",
                 group: comment.user?.group || "",
                 floor: `【${floor}楼】`,
                 time: formatTime(comment.create_time),
                 content: comment.content
             });
         }
         if (comment._?.forEach) {
             comment._.forEach((child, index) => {
                 child.floorIndex = index + 1;
                 collectMyComments(child, floor);
             });
         }
     }
  
     // 处理全部评论数据 
     function buildComments(comment, parentPath, level = 0) {
         let floor = parentPath ? `${parentPath}-${comment.floorIndex}` : comment.floorIndex;
         let indent = '  '.repeat(level);
         let str = `${indent}⏱️${formatTime(comment.create_time)}\n` +
 
 `${indent}👤${comment.user?.username || "已注销用户"} | ${comment.user?.group || ""}\n` +
                   `${indent}💬 ${comment.content}\n` +
                   `${indent}📍 ${floor}楼\n\n`;
  
         if (comment._?.forEach) {
             comment._.forEach((child, index) => {
                 child.floorIndex = index + 1;
                 str += buildComments(child, floor, level + 1);
             });
         }
         return str;
     }

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

}

var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
//java.log(form);
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);
//java.log(charset);
//桌面版UA
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36";
//手机版UA
var uam = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 7.0; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/48.0.2564.116 Mobile Safari/537.36 T7/10.3 SearchCraft/2.6.2 (baiduboxapp; P1 7.0)";
var headers = {
    //请自行选择UA，↓↓↓填入此处
    "User-Agent" : uaw, "Referer" : String(baseUrl)
};
url = baseUrl.replace(/([^\/])$/i, '$1/') + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
//java.log(sk);
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);

<js>
//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var HH = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(H(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var II = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(I(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var convertToWordArray = function(string) {
    var lWordCount;
    var lMessageLength = string.length;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempOne = lMessageLength + 8;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempTwo = (lNumberOfWordsTempOne - (lNumberOfWordsTempOne % 64)) / 64;
    var lNumberOfWords = (lNumberOfWordsTempTwo + 1) * 16;
    var lWordArray = Array(lNumberOfWords - 1);
    var lBytePosition = 0;
    var lByteCount = 0;
    while (lByteCount < lMessageLength) {
        lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
        lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
        lWordArray[lWordCount] = (lWordArray[lWordCount] | (string.charCodeAt(lByteCount) << lBytePosition));
        lByteCount++
    }
    lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
    lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
    lWordArray[lWordCount] = lWordArray[lWordCount] | (0x80 << lBytePosition);
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 2] = lMessageLength << 3;
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 1] = lMessageLength >>> 29;
    return lWordArray
};
var wordToHex = function(lValue) {
    var WordToHexValue = "",
    WordToHexValueTemp = "",
    lByte, lCount;
    for (lCount = 0; lCount <= 3; lCount++) {
        lByte = (lValue >>> (lCount * 8)) & 255;
        WordToHexValueTemp = "0" + lByte.toString(16);
        WordToHexValue = WordToHexValue + WordToHexValueTemp.substr(WordToHexValueTemp.length - 2, 2)
    }
    return WordToHexValue
};
var uTF8Encode = function(string) {
    string = string.replace(/\x0d\x0a/g, "\x0a");
    var output = "";
    for (var n = 0; n < string.length; n++) {
        var c = string.charCodeAt(n);
        if (c < 128) {

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "未分组": []
  }
  // java.log(
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(group_bookids["未分组"]))
  // java.log(decodeURIComponent(name))
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
  //java.log("awa")
  let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 100)
  let urls = []

  book_ids.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.bookSourceUrl + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
  })
  
  res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

  let resp = {book_info: []}
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })

  return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
	  "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32",
	  null,
	  ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    // java.log(JSON.stringify(i.book_data))
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else result = JSON.parse(result)
}
JSON.stringify({data: result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data})

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

content=java.getElement("$.content");
saybody=java.getString("$.sayBody");
say=saybody!=""?"\n作者有话要说：\n"+saybody:"";

result=String(decode(content)+say);

var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|章节目录|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, '') + ' • ' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-'),
	intro: '　　🔸最近更新：' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + og('description').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|分享书籍.*|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
url:og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>
